objective: Implement the smallest generic Semantic Binding vNext seam so a VF Workspace can validate and consume an explicitly pinned external semantic contract without owning/rewriting PIM truth: PIM stays canonical semantic authority (read-only reference); VF local ids remain local; binding is an explicit local->canonical relationship; required bindings fail closed; compatibility decision and runtime authorization stay separate (SH-WTP: compatible_with_constraints + NOT_AUTHORIZED); semantic admission fails before domain advancement; consumed contract version/SHA thread into existing G2 provenance fields (semantic_contract_version / semantic_contract_sha) without changing G2 authority; no SH-WTP runtime/topology/physics/control implementation; no G10.
explicit_non_objectives: No cross-workspace integration or data exchange
No PIM canonical id generation/rename/repair by VF
No dynamic main/latest fetch at runtime
No change to G2 provenance authority
No redesign of G7 lifecycle (bounded pre-run/admission seam only)
No reinterpretation of compatible_with_constraints as unconditional compatible
No fabrication of semantic provenance when no contract is consumed
forbidden_actions: Generate/rename/repair PIM canonical ids in VF
Fabricate semantic provenance when no contract consumed
stop_conditions: Implementation requires deciding that compatible_with_constraints equals unconditional compatible for runtime admission
PIM canonical ids must be generated/renamed/repaired by VF
Name-based or heuristic binding is required
Semantic source must float to external main/latest at runtime
G2 provenance authority must be changed
G7 lifecycle semantics must be redesigned
Cross-workspace data exchange or supply-chain semantics are introduced

acceptance_criteria.description: Generic semantic-binding model + validator with fail-closed required-mode rules
Deterministic pinned binding artifact/loader seam (no network, exact pins)
Bounded run-control admission seam: required binding invalid/NOT_AUTHORIZED blocks start/advance with zero domain advancement
Consumed semantic contract version/SHA thread exactly into provenance; no fabrication when absent
Compatibility decision and runtime authorization remain separate; SH-WTP stays compatible_with_constraints + NOT_AUTHORIZED
TIPA/continuous, G8 canonical baseline, full suite remain green
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
